name: Learn-Forge SaaS Platform
desc: A production-ready e-learning SaaS platform built with Vue.js and FastAPI. Delivers course management, student progress tracking, interactive quizzes, subscription billing, and a powerful admin dashboard — all backed by a scalable PostgreSQL database with full REST API architecture.

name: Grains & Grounds
desc: A designer-focused web interface for a specialty coffee brand. Built with semantic HTML5 and vanilla CSS, it features a clean responsive layout, dynamic tabbed menus, and smooth scroll animations for a premium digital storefront and seamless user navigation.

name: Amber perfume web
desc: A minimalist, high-performance luxury e-commerce web application with dynamic fragrance family filtering, visual scent breakdown guides, interactive shopping cart capabilities, and smooth UI animations — built using vanilla HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript.

name: PTTX to PDF Merger
desc: A professional utility that converts and merges multiple PowerPoint (.pptx) files into a single, organized PDF document. Powered by Microsoft PowerPoint COM automation for high-fidelity, layout-perfect PDF output.

name: GitSyncPro
desc: A one-click GitHub push and auto-sync utility for Windows. GitSync Pro watches your project, auto-detects what changed, and pushes to GitHub from a global hotkey or a single Quick Sync popup — no terminal required.
